text:
Type: upholstered footstool with turned legs
Use: resting feet, extra seating, a soft coffee table with a tray; living room, family room
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: grey-brown woven fabric cover, piped seams, padded cushion top, turned black-stained wood legs
Colors: warm taupe grey, black legs
Shape: wide low rectangular top with a thick piped cushion, shallow apron, four turned spindle legs, generous but low
Feel: elegant, cozy, relaxed, timeless
Goes with: matching sofas, dark wood, grey and beige textiles, brass accents; traditional or classic living rooms

product.name: STOCKSUND
product.description: Works as an extra seat or a comfortable extension of your sofa.
